scripts.build:tools: bun build src/tools/pinterest-theme/content.ts --outfile=extension/dist/tools/pinterest-theme.js --target=browser --format=iife && bun build src/tools/task-namer/overlay.ts --outfile=extension/dist/tools/task-namer.js --target=browser --format=iife
scripts.build:tools:assets: mkdir -p extension/dist/tools && cp src/tools/pinterest-theme/theme.css extension/dist/tools/pinterest-theme.css && cp src/tools/task-namer/overlay.css extension/dist/tools/task-namer.css
scripts.build:popup: bun run build:popup:js && bun run build:popup:assets && bun run build:popup:html && bun run build:popup:css
scripts.build:options: mkdir -p extension/dist/options && bun build src/options/index.ts --outfile=extension/dist/options/options.js --target=browser --format=esm && cp src/options/index.html extension/dist/options/index.html
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:tools && bun run build:tools:assets && bun run build:popup && bun run build:options && bun run build:background
scripts.dev: bun run build && (bun run dev:tools & bun run dev:overlay & bun run dev:popup & bun run dev:background & bun run dev:css & wait)
